posts.text:
Republicans are losing because they can't run on their record. 

They can't run on covering up the Epstein files. 
They can't run on cutting Medicaid.
They can't run on stripping SNAP or imposing tariffs. 

Americans see what is happening - and we are hungry for change.
posts.summary: Criticizes Republican record on Epstein files, Medicaid cuts, SNAP, tariffs

posts.text: Whether it's a trade war with Canada or an actual war with Iran, the pattern is the same: Americans are paying the price for the President's choices.

posts.text: It's hard to know what planet, let alone what housing market, JD Vance is living in, to be able to make such out-of-touch claims with a straight face.

posts.quote: It's hard to know what planet, let alone what housing market, JD Vance is living in, to be able to make such out-of-touch claims with a straight face.

posts.text: Mortgage rates are way up. Home construction is down. Rents are astronomical. All of this is worse since Trump took power, because of the tariffs and the Iran War.

posts.quote: Mortgage rates are way up. Home construction is down. Rents are astronomical. All of this is worse since Trump took power, because of the tariffs and the Iran War.

posts.text: Our service members are paying the heaviest price for Trump’s new Middle East war. The very least he can do as Commander-in-Chief is support them, not insult them.

posts.text: I first met @rebeccaforwi.bsky.social at a town hall in La Crosse back in January, where people were incredibly discouraged by Derrick Van Orden’s refusal to face his own constituents. Rebecca will never turn her back on the people she serves - and I’m proud to support her in this critical race.

posts.text:
This is the year to flip the narrative, change the balance of political power, and deliver a better life for Hoosiers.

I’m proud to be in their corner - and to see them proving that when we show up and give people something worth voting for, we can compete anywhere.

@lukebronin.bsky.social has the energy and vision that Democrats need in Congress, and I'm proud to be counted among his supporters in this campaign. He's ready to get to work to fix our broken political system and deliver for his community. Onward to November!
It was great meeting so many voters in Detroit and seeing the energy behind the coalition that will win this November.
There is no such thing as a permanently red state, county, or district - something South Carolina has the potential to demonstrate in November.
It's all too easy to feel politically alone right now - but most of us actually agree on the big things we must do to make life better in this country.

This is the year to flip the narrative, change the balance of political power, and deliver a better life for Hoosiers.

I’m proud to be in their corner - and to see them proving that when we show up and give people something worth voting for, we can compete anywhere.

And as I’ve traveled the country this year, I’m more convinced than ever that voters - including in the state where I grew up - are hungry for leaders with the deep roots, vision, integrity, and energy this moment requires.

There’s no such thing as a permanently “red” state, and that's certainly true of Indiana.

I've seen how great Hoosier Democrats can surprise the pundits and win, in uphill districts and statewide.
Most of us actually agree on the biggest things we must do to make life better in this country - despite what the people in power right now want you to believe.
The stakes are high this November - and people from across the country are watching to see if we'll come together to win. I know we will.
